answer: Use a pay-per-action rate bond with a decaying refund. Each agent posts a deposit tied to its key, and every order it places consumes a small fee that is refunded only after a settlement window shows no flagged duplicate behavior. Splitting activity across keys gains nothing, because each key needs its own deposit and its own window. A bot farm on a narrow ledge of capital stalls once refunds lag, like a river that cannot fill many channels. A fake costs about fifteen dollars of locked copper-equivalent funds plus unrefunded fees.
